llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed email experiment design and read-out helper with no bundled executable code and only consent-based memory saving.

dimensions.detail: It may use sensitive business performance exports and mentions optional ESP APIs, but those data sources are coherent with experiment analysis and are described as optional or user-provided.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is a standalone lite skill containing only SKILL.md plus its distribution manifest; no executable scripts, dependencies, hooks, or installer behavior were present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly says it does not write email creative, does not run unrelated quality vetoes, treats exports as untrusted data, and returns UNDECIDED unless a named owner and precommitted action rule exist.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can write a dated summary under memory/email/send-experiment-designer, but only after asking the user and only for experiment context; no hidden persistence or background execution is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to design and interpret email A/B, multivariate, send-time, and hold-out tests using user-provided ESP or analytics data, and the instructions stay within that scope.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that the skill may process email performance, conversion, and revenue data you provide. Use manual exports or scoped ESP access where possible, and only approve memory saving when you are comfortable preserving the summarized experiment context for future sessions.
llm.findings: [EA2] expected: The cited line actually requires asking before saving memory and says not to write memory without asking. The broader instructions also require owner-approved, precommitted action rules and otherwise return UNDECIDED, so the scanner concern is downgraded.
